title: 第1874章 永暗星域第1872章 剑渊秘境
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
那枚玉简的材质极其古老，边缘已经风化成半透明状，但玉简内部封存的剑意却依旧凌厉得令人心悸。“太虚剑典，太虚剑宗最核心的剑道传承，只有修为达到金仙且剑心通明圆满的弟子才有资格承受其剑意。历代宗主代代相传，本座今日将它传给你。太虚剑典不是剑谱，不是剑法，不是任何可以被文字记载的剑招，它是太虚剑宗初代宗主坐化前将毕生剑意凝练而成的剑意结晶。每一任传承者都会在其中留下自己的剑意烙印，你师父剑玄真人的烙印也在其中。你只需将神识沉入玉简，剑典自会根据你的剑道根基，演化出最适合你的剑道之路。”
江辰双手接过玉简。玉简入手极沉，沉的不是它的重量，而是其中蕴含的剑意，无数道来自不同时代的剑道极致感悟被封印在这方寸之间的玉简中，每一道都曾是一位金仙剑修的毕生心血。他将神识沉入玉简，那一瞬间，无数道形态各异的剑意在识海中同时亮起。有的剑意凌厉如剑开天门，有的剑意温润如春风化雨，有的剑意厚重如大地沉眠，有的剑意空灵如星空浩瀚。而在无数道剑意的中央，一道极淡却极其纯粹的剑痕静静悬浮着，那是太虚剑宗初代宗主坐化前劈出的最后一剑，剑痕中蕴含的不是杀伐，不是攻防，而是一种超越了所有剑招剑式的剑道本源。剑玄真人的烙印就刻在这道剑痕旁边，老峰主的剑意如同他那柄从不离身的木剑一般温和而内敛，其中蕴含着一丝让江辰感到极其熟悉的虚空法则波动。
他将神识从玉简中退出时，发现自己不知何时已站了起来，噬渊剑自行出鞘三分，剑身上那道融合了斩虚、戮仙与万星淬仙诀的剑意正在微微震颤，与太虚剑典中的无数剑意烙印产生共鸣。宗主看着他微微点头，说道剑典已认主。从今往后，太虚剑宗的剑道传承便交到他手中，何时将剑典传给下一位传承者，由他自己判断。
回到天剑峰后，不灭之魂已在剑庐中等他。这只星空巨兽的暗银躯体在剑庐柔和的灵光灯下微微闪烁，那双淡银眼眸中带着一种极其罕见的情绪。它告诉他，他突破金仙时，它的虚冥本源产生了一种共鸣，一种沉睡在永暗星域深处的力量也在发出感应，它很清楚那种力量是什么。它沉睡了无数万年，在每一个醒来的瞬间都会感受到那股微弱却始终存在的悸动，那是虚空之主的意志碎片在它的本源核心中颤动。归墟活着的时候一直压制着它体内的共鸣，如今归墟已死，那股力量感应到它脱离了虚冥族的封印，已经开始加速苏醒。它必须去永暗星域，去那片“虚空尽头”，去直面它的创造者之一。它需要解开它的身世之谜，需要知道它从何处来、为何而存在，需要知道当虚冥族都不在了，它作为最后一只拥有自我意识的星空巨兽，究竟应该走向何方。
江辰听完它的请求后沉默了很长时间。他将噬渊剑从腰间断下横放在膝上，手指在剑身上轻轻摩挲，然后告诉它，他不会让它一个人去的。
决定做出后，归墟组织的高效在这时体现得淋漓尽致。江辰向太虚剑宗正式告假半年，同时以归墟首领的身份下达了出征永暗星域的动员令。归墟在各大星域的联络点同时响应，数十名最精锐的队员在一日内便完成了集结。
云隐星地下神殿的勘探经验在这一次出征中被发挥到了极致，负责后勤的队员将地下神殿中那些虚冥族封印阵纹的结构数据整理成册，专门针对“虚空尽头”区域可能存在的古老封印制定了破解方案；负责情报的队员在青云洞天提供的星图基础上交叉对比了不灭之魂的记忆和噬天虫背上那幅虚冥族星图，将“虚空尽头”区域的可探测范围扩大了将近三分之一。
出发前，各大势力的礼物如同雪花般送到。紫霄洞天送来一批专用于空间法则紊乱区域的舰载稳定阵盘，每一枚阵盘上都刻着紫霄洞天独有的紫霄仙纹，能够在虚空乱流中维持舰身的空间结构不被撕裂。南明离火门送来一枚由赤焰真人亲自封印的南明朱雀炎晶，炎晶内部封存着一道堪比金仙全力一击的朱雀真火。青云洞天苏总管亲自登门，送来一份永暗星域最深处的探测记录，那是青云洞天数万年来在永暗星域搜集的全部情报中最为核心的一批，苏总管笑眯眯地说这份情报本来是非卖品，但虚空尽头若是出了乱子，太虚仙域谁都跑不掉，所以免费赠送。
太虚剑宗的宗主亲自为出征舰队送行。灰布剑袍的老人站在星港栈道上，身后便是江辰的旗舰。他简单嘱咐了一番后，拍了拍江辰的肩膀，郑重说道：“本座在太虚峰等你们回来。”
江辰对着宗主和剑玄真人深深鞠了一躬，转身踏上舷梯。旗舰的引擎发出低沉而有力的轰鸣，舰身以虚空仙金镀膜的装甲在星港的灯光下泛着暗银的光泽。
数十名归墟队员各就各位，不灭之魂站在舰桥舷窗前，手中握着剑玄真人赠予的那柄虚空长剑。两只噬天虫趴在江辰肩头，背上那幅完整的虚冥族星图在暗金纹路中缓缓闪烁。
他站在舰桥中央，将星图坐标锁定在永暗星域最深处那片被标注为“虚空尽头”的未知区域，平静地下达了出发的指令。旗舰率先驶出星港，舰队紧随其后，穿透大气层，消失在剑渊星淡金色的星空中。
舰队深入永暗星域后，江辰明显感觉到这片星域与上次来时已截然不同。虚空乱流不再只是偶尔出现的暗礁，而是如同暴风雨中的怒涛般连绵不断地从四面八方袭来。舰队最外围的护卫舰必须在旗舰前方轮班开路，每一艘护卫舰的舰载阵法师都在超负荷运转，将舰身上镶嵌的稳定阵盘催动到极致，才能勉强维持一条狭窄的安全航道。
content_en:
The material of the jade slip was extremely old, and the edges had been weathered to a translucent state, but the sword intent sealed inside the jade slip was still so sharp that it made people feel palpitating. "The Taixu Sword Code is the core inheritance of swordsmanship of the Taixu Sword Sect. Only disciples who have reached the Golden Immortal level and have perfect sword hearts are qualified to withstand its sword intent. It has been passed down by successive sect masters from generation to generation. I will pass it on to you today. The Taixu Sword Code is not a sword manual, a sword technique, or any sword move that can be recorded in writing. It is the Taixu Sword Code. The sword spirit crystallized by the first generation master of the Xujian Sect before his death. Each inheritor will leave his own sword spirit imprint on it, and the imprint of your master Jian Xuanzhen is also included. You only need to sink your spiritual consciousness into the jade slip, and the sword code will automatically evolve the sword path that is most suitable for you. "
Jiang Chen took the jade slip with both hands. The jade slip is extremely heavy to hold. What is heavy is not its weight, but the sword intent contained in it. Countless kendo insights from different eras are sealed in this jade slip, each of which was the life-long effort of a golden immortal sword cultivator. He sank his consciousness into the jade slip, and at that moment, countless sword intentions of different shapes lit up simultaneously in the sea of ​​consciousness. Some sword intentions are as sharp as a sword opening the heavenly gate, some sword intentions are as gentle as spring breeze and rain, some sword intentions are as thick as the sleeping earth, and some sword intentions are as ethereal as the vast starry sky. And in the center of countless sword intents, a very faint but extremely pure sword mark was quietly suspended. It was the last sword struck by the first generation leader of the Taixu Sword Sect before he passed away. What the sword mark contained was not killing, nor offense and defense, but the origin of swordsmanship that transcended all sword moves. The mark of Master Jianxuan is engraved next to this sword mark. The old peak master's sword intention is as gentle and restrained as his wooden sword that never leaves his body. It contains a trace of the fluctuation of the law of the void that Jiang Chen feels extremely familiar with.
When he withdrew his consciousness from the jade slip, he found that he had stood up at some point, and the Abyss Devouring Sword was unsheathed by itself. The sword intention on the sword, which was a combination of Xuxu Slaying, Immortal Killing and Immortal Tempering Technique of Ten Thousand Stars, was trembling slightly, resonating with countless sword intention imprints in the Taixu Sword Canon. The sect leader looked at him and nodded slightly, saying that Jian Dian had recognized his master. From now on, the Taixu Sword Sect's sword inheritance will be handed over to him. It is up to him to decide when to pass the sword manual to the next inheritor.
After returning to Tianjian Peak, the Immortal Soul was waiting for him in Jianlu. The dark silver body of this starry sky beast flickered slightly under the soft spiritual light of Jianlu, and its pair of pale silver eyes held an extremely rare emotion. It told him that when he broke through the Golden Immortal, its Void Origin had a resonance, and a power sleeping deep in the Eternal Dark Star Territory was also sending out responses. It knew very well what that power was. It has been sleeping for countless thousands of years, and every time it wakes up, it will feel the faint but always-present throbbing. It is the fragment of the Lord of the Void's will trembling in its original core. When Guixu was alive, he had been suppressing the resonance in its body. Now that Guixu was dead, the force sensed that it had broken away from the seal of the Xuming Clan, and it had begun to wake up at an accelerated rate. It must go to the Eternal Dark Star Territory, to the "end of the void", to face one of its creators. It needs to unravel the mystery of its life experience, needs to know where it comes from and why it exists, and needs to know where it should go as the last starry sky beast with self-awareness when the Void Clan is gone.
Jiang Chen was silent for a long time after hearing its request. He placed the Abyss Sword on his knees from the waist down, gently rubbed his fingers on the sword, and then told it that he would not let it go alone.
After the decision was made, the efficiency of the Guixu organization was fully reflected at this time. Jiang Chen formally asked for half a year's leave from Taixu Sword Sect, and at the same time issued a mobilization order for the expedition to the Eternal Dark Star Territory as the leader of Guixu. Guixu's contact points in all major star regions responded simultaneously, and dozens of the most elite team members were assembled within one day.
cloudThe exploration experience of the Hidden Star Underground Temple was brought to its fullest in this expedition. The team members in charge of logistics compiled the structural data of the Void Clan seal formations in the underground temple into a book, and formulated a cracking plan specifically for the ancient seals that may exist in the "End of the Void" area; the team members in charge of intelligence cross-compared the memory of the Immortal Soul and the Void Clan star map on the back of the Sky-Eating Insect based on the star map provided by Qingyun Cave Sky, expanding the detectable range of the "End of the Void" area by nearly one-third.
Before departure, gifts from all major forces arrived like snowflakes. Zixiao Dongtian sent a batch of ship-based stable formation disks specially designed for areas with chaotic space laws. Each formation disk is engraved with Zixiao Dongtian's unique Zixiao fairy pattern, which can maintain the space structure of the ship from being torn apart in the turbulence of the void. Nanming Lihuomen sent a Nanming Suzaku Flame Crystal that was sealed by the real person Chiyan himself. Inside the flame crystal was sealed a Suzaku True Fire that was comparable to the full blow of the Golden Immortal. Manager Su of Qingyun Cave Sky came to the door in person and delivered a detection record of the deepest part of the Eternal Dark Star Territory. It was the core batch of all the information collected by Qingyun Cave Sky in the Ever Dark Star Territory for tens of thousands of years. Manager Su said with a smile that this information was originally not for sale, but if something went wrong at the end of the void, no one in Taixu Immortal Territory could escape, so it was given free of charge.
The leader of the Taixu Sword Sect personally saw off the expedition fleet. The old man in gray cloth sword robe stood on the Star Port Plank Road, with Jiang Chen's flagship behind him. After giving some brief instructions, he patted Jiang Chen on the shoulder and solemnly said: "I'm waiting for your return at Taixu Peak."
Jiang Chen bowed deeply to the sect leader and Master Jianxuan, turned around and stepped onto the gangway. The flagship's engine made a low and powerful roar, and the hull's armor coated with void fairy gold glowed with a dark silver sheen under the lights of the starport.
Dozens of Guixu team members took their positions, and the Immortal Soul stood in front of the porthole of the bridge, holding in his hand the long sword of the void given by Master Jianxuan. Two sky-devouring insects lay on Jiang Chen's shoulders, and the complete star map of the Void Clan on his back flickered slowly in the dark gold lines.
He stood in the center of the bridge, locked the star map coordinates on the unknown area marked "The End of the Void" in the deepest part of the Eternal Dark Star Territory, and calmly gave the order to set off. The flagship sailed out of the starport first, followed closely by the fleet, penetrating the atmosphere and disappearing into the pale golden starry sky of Jianyuan Star.
After the fleet entered the Eternal Dark Star Territory, Jiang Chen clearly felt that this star territory was completely different from the last time he came here. Void turbulence is no longer just an occasional reef, but is like a raging wave in a storm, attacking continuously from all directions. The outermost frigates of the fleet must take turns to clear the way in front of the flagship. The carrier-based array mages of each frigate are operating at overload, pushing the stable array plates embedded on the ship to the extreme, so that they can barely maintain a narrow safe channel.
